calls.title: Flexport + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The team is undertaking a comprehensive website overhaul, migrating from Contentful to Sanity CMS and transitioning from Gatsby to Astro for improved usability and faster content creation via AI tools. The hosting is moving from Netlify to Cloudflare, guided by engineering support for backend implementation. A CEO-driven initiative emphasizes the need for robust A/B testing beyond Google Analytics, prioritizing quick experiment setup and rapid access to results. Proper server-side rendering is essential to improve performance, with attention to core web vitals. GrowthBook is being evaluated as an experimentation platform, offering flexible self-hosted and cloud options to align with privacy and performance needs. Integration challenges with Salesforce for linking experiment data to lead quality metrics are also being discussed, along with ensuring deeper project insights through comprehensive demo experiences.
calls.keywords: AB testing, server-side rendering, Sanity CMS, CRM integration, experimentation platform, safe rollout

calls.title: Flexport + GrowthBook Demo
calls.summary: During the meeting, the team discussed integrating GrowthBook with Salesforce and Clay to enhance lead quality through real-time enrichment. Natalie Barzyk confirmed that Clay would replace LeanData for lead enrichment via webhook, while Logan Bates emphasized GrowthBook's ability to send experiment exposure data immediately. They explored feature-based experimentation to enable flexible campaign testing and the use of AI-driven workflows to streamline experiment management. Importantly, metrics will integrate diverse data sources like GA4 and Salesforce for nuanced lead quality tracking. A cautious approach to initial user testing was proposed, along with significant focus on a structured pricing model, fostering a supportive collaboration environment to achieve optimal experimentation outcomes.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Salesforce Integration, Experimentation, Lead Quality, API Automation, Visual Editor
